This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
Max slew - design repair only sees the typical corner, but slews in nom_slow_1p08V_125C are
up to 1.66x larger (same 2.507ns limit): repair to half the limit, again after global routing.
Wire length cap: the execute enable (fanout 8, 871um routed) escaped slew-based repair.
Memories: per SM an IMEM, IHP SRAM RM_IHPSG13_1P_64x16_c2 (236.80 x 64.36 um, src/imem_sram.v),
and a FIFO SRAM, RM_IHPSG13_1P_256x16_c2_bm_bist (236.80 x 118.78 um, src/fifo_ram_sram.v);
views from the PDK (sg13cmos5l_sram is the SG13G2 SRAM library). In a row along the bottom of
the core, 20 um channels between them, FS: their signal pins (bottom edge) face up, towards
the logic. Recipe from UW-ASIC/TinyTracer, after kdp1965/ihp-um-janestreet-prism.
VDD! (periphery) and VDDARRAY! (bit cells) on VPWR, VSS! on VGND.
The tile PDN is Metal4 stripes only and the SRAM blocks Metal2-Metal4, so pdngen stops its
stripes at the macro. pdn_cfg.tcl drops LibreLane's empty per-macro grid; the step
Project.ExtendPowerStripes (librelane_plugin_openpio_pdn.py, odb_stripes.py) redraws the
stripes through the macro on its Metal4 supply columns.
GeneratePDN checks the grid before ExtendPowerStripes connects the SRAM: it always counts
the SRAM as unconnected. LVS (unmatched pins) is the check that the SRAM is powered.
Magic misreads the SRAM's LEF obstructions (false illegal overlaps at the VDD!/VDDARRAY!
break); the precheck's KLayout DRC on the real GDS is the DRC sign-off. LVS treats the
SRAM as a black box (its CDL is not LVS clean).
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
